corpus.label_method: Ground truth authored from visually inspected app UI and synthetic source strings before OCR; no OCR output used to set labels. Targets are a declared subset, not exhaustive transcription.

boundaries.measured: Process-cold one-shot JSON CLI image OCR wall time: startup/guard+PNG I/O/decode+Tesseract+merge+JSON; OS page caches are not flushed

measurement.label_scoring: Case-insensitive edge-punctuation-normalized exact phrase/space-folded target recall; labelled-word multiset recall. Labels are a subset of visible text, not a precision/CER claim.

build_kind: Existing optimized release CLI before adaptive OCR changes; exact binary SHA256 above

representative_lines: Open your app, build it and run it on a device.
Open your app, build it and run it on a device.

confirmed_recovery.type: existing real app frame, crop only

recommended_guards: Keep auto exhaustive/default for full text coverage and OCR-driven ambiguity checks; never and adaptive are explicit tradeoffs.
A requested target miss, no words, or low confidence should trigger inversion; one confident target does not prove complete screen text coverage.
Retain every matching target; duplicateContinue fixture has two matches in both legacy modes, and no index is selected by the benchmark.
Expose recognizer invocations and cache reuse separately from pass count; query changes may reuse first polarity but must not cache away a miss fallback.
Cache key must include frozen image content, language, confidence and region; adaptive target/index/fuzzy changes need independent fallback decisions.
Use region when the requested control occupies a minority colour area; evaluate ROI labels separately from the full image.
No OCR-language quality claim beyond installed eng; accented Latin controls are intentionally not accent-folded to manufacture success.
Report full labelled-target/word recall beside target hit and timing; focus/ROI duplicates are excluded from aggregate independent-image metrics.
Process-cold CLI numbers include PNG and process overhead and cannot be compared to another product's device/simulator read-screen table.
limitations: Hand-labelled target subset, not exhaustive transcription or precision/CER benchmark
Selected stress corpus, not a random production distribution
Compressed demo-video crops are not native-resolution fresh phone screenshots
Only3 timing trials per case/mode; OS page caches unflushed and host load uncontrolled
No device latency, input, PhoneUse or FPS measured
